_comment: Remaining entries are Kintone figures DERIVED from the canonical amount (e.g. 10 users x 12 months = P126,000 at P1,050) or UI placeholders. They are arithmetically correct at the current price but are NOT auto-synced, so they must be rechecked whenever data/pricing.json changes. validate-pricing.mjs WARNS on these and FAILS on anything new.

notes.monday-com-pricing: P10,830 is Monday.com's own figure in an adjacent table cell - competitor pricing, false positive
notes.odoo-alternative: P126,000 = 10 users x 12 months at canonical price
notes.odoo-pricing: P126,000 / P126K/yr = 10 users x 12 months; P378K = 10 users x 36 months, at canonical price
notes.hubspot-pricing: P1,755,200 = annual saving vs HubSpot; Kintone annual P300,000 = (20 users x canonical price + Brevo P4,000/mo) x 12
notes.manufacturing: P126K = 10 users x 12 months; P21,000/mo = 20 users, both at canonical price
notes.custom-crm: P140,000 is Salesforce's figure in an adjacent column; the 'Kintone Custom CRM' text is a table header - false positive
notes.zoho-crm-review: ~P10,500/mo = 10 users x canonical price (Kintone column of the Zoho comparison table)
notes.why-edamame-kintone-partner: P126K = 10 users x 12 months at canonical price (licences only; implementation quoted)
